title: Sequential Additivity in Distributionally Robust Ranking and Selection
abstract: arXiv:2509.06147v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Ranking and selection (R&S) seeks to identify the alternative with the best mean performance from a finite collection of simulated alternatives. Its practical value depends on accurate simulation input modeling, which is often hindered by input uncertainty arising from limited data. Distributionally robust R&S (DRR&S) addresses this challenge by considering several plausible input distributions and selecting the alternative with the best worst-case mean performance, resulting in a multiplicative number of scenarios. Existing static and oracle analyses suggest that efficient sampling should instead be additive, concentrating on only a small number of critical scenarios. We introduce sequential additivity, which characterizes how this structure emerges from adaptive sequential procedures. We first establish an algorithm-independent sampling lower bound: any consistent DRR&S procedure must sample at least this additive number of s

translated_title: 分布鲁棒排序与选择中的序贯可加性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2509.06147v2 公告类型：跨版本替换 摘要：排序与选择（R&S）旨在从有限数量的模拟候选项中识别出具有最佳均值表现的选项。其实际价值依赖于准确的模拟输入建模，而这常因有限数据导致的输入不确定性而受阻。分布鲁棒排序与选择（DRR&S）通过考虑多个可能的输入分布，并选择具有最佳最坏情况均值表现的选项来应对这一挑战，这导致情景数量呈乘性增长。现有的静态和预言机分析表明，高效采样应具有可加性，仅集中于少数关键情景。我们引入了序贯可加性，用以刻画这种结构如何从自适应序贯程序中涌现。我们首先建立了一个算法无关的采样下界：任何一致的DRR&S程序必须至少采样这一可加数量的样本。
tldr: 本文提出序贯可加性概念，证明分布鲁棒排序与选择中自适应采样只需可加数量关键情景，并给出算法无关下界。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces sequential additivity, showing that adaptive sampling in distributionally robust ranking and selection requires only an additive number of critical scenarios, with an algorithm-independent lower bound established.
